verdict.rationale: n8n's pricing page lists Git-based version control, and its docs have a "Push and pull changes" page under a "use-source-control-and-environments" URL. That points to a first-party source-control and environments feature, but the evidence is only headings. The dev-to-production promotion workflow itself is never actually described. Missing for 10: documented environment setup and the steps for promoting from dev to prod, details on what gets versioned (workflows, credentials, variables), plan or tier requirements, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can version workflows through source control or environments and promote changes from dev to production
